evidence.note: Pru-CoT quantifies each reasoning step's causal contribution via gradient-based optimization of a learnable soft-masking weight on a frozen student LLM (masking a step toward a filler-token embedding and seeing how much the prediction loss spikes), then uses an LLM-guided pruning agent to synthesize a concise, logically-coherent chain anchored on the high-weight steps -- beating token-level, prompt-based, and search-based pruning baselines, improving DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B's average accuracy 2.4% while cutting tokens, and running 4.4x faster than the strongest search-based baseline (A*-Thought).
evidence.title: Pru-CoT: Towards Efficient Reasoning Distillation via Pruning Chain-of-Thought
